brief_v2.history_line: Google Search Restructure – Heating Season marked done · Fibid GBP verification appeal submitted · Burr Ridge GBP verification marked done

performance.verdict: Spend collapse is intentional throttle, but 9 overdue SOW milestones now block heating season.

findings.text: CPL rose 19.91% week-over-week to ~$43.86 on only 34 leads in 28 days; all 34 attributable to Meta alone — Google Ads shows 0 tracked conversions.

9 SOW milestones are overdue, including Heating campaigns live (due 2026-10-01), LSA re-enable (due 2026-09-01), and intake owner confirmation (due 2026-08-31) — all unresolved entering peak heating season.

3-day lead signal (Oct 27–29): 0+2+1 = 3 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 24–26): 1+0+2 = 3 leads — flat. But daily spend collapsed from ~$63 to ~$30, meaning cost-per-lead is rising structurally, not cyclically.
GHL shows 770 opportunities created but only 86 won (11.2% win rate) in 28 days, with 0 appointments logged — intake leak probable given confirmed dispatch seat vacancy since 7/7.
GBP actions surged 33.33% week-over-week (144 actions in 28 days, 98 direction requests) while paid leads fell — organic is holding; paid infrastructure is the gap.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately; 770 opps at 11.2% win rate signals leads are arriving but not being worked.
suggestions.monday_update: The dispatch seat has been vacant since 7/7 and this milestone was due 2026-08-31. GHL shows 770 opportunities created but only 86 won (11.2%) with 0 appointments logged — leads may be arriving and going cold. Confirm who owns intake, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is in place. Success check: named intake owner with active GHL login confirmed by 2026-11-03.

suggestions.text: Escalate Heating campaigns live milestone (due 2026-10-01, now 29 days overdue) — heating season is active with $790.53 already in BWS-Heating-Search-Calls.
suggestions.monday_update: The Heating campaigns live milestone (Google & Meta) was due 2026-10-01 and is 29 days overdue. The top campaign BWS-Heating-Search-Calls has absorbed $790.53 of the 28-day budget but Google Ads shows 0 tracked conversions, and Meta is carrying all 34 attributed leads at a CPL of $43.86. LSA re-enable (due 2026-09-01) and Fall creative package (due 2026-09-30) are also outstanding. Confirm with Nacer what is blocking go-live and resolve pixel/conversion tracking on Google before any budget is raised. Success check: heating campaign confirmed live with conversion tracking verified by 2026-11-06.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL trend for 3 more days; at $43.86 CPL with flat 3-day lead signal, do not scale until intake is confirmed and Google tracking is fixed.
suggestions.monday_item_name: Watch Meta CPL — No Scale Yet
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is the only channel producing attributed leads (34 in 28 days, CPL $43.86, up 19.91% week-over-week). The 3-day lead signal is flat (3 leads Oct 27–29 vs 3 leads Oct 24–26) and Google Ads shows 0 conversions. Scaling Meta spend before intake is staffed and Google tracking is repaired risks burning budget into a leaky funnel. Re-check on 2026-11-03: if CPL holds below $50 and intake owner is confirmed, a ≤20% Meta budget increase becomes defensible.
